data_a.situation: The coordinator has written a note asking the workroom manager to place a block order with Menkes Blockworks for job QM-2031-0533. The draft is attached as an image.
known_facts: Menkes Blockworks cut each dome block to one exact crown circumference and reject an order that gives a range.
The cutting slot held for QM-2031-0533 is Friday 10 October at 08:00 and is released to another order if the form is incomplete when Menkes open it.
The commission is for Marchmont Enclosure and cannot be cut until the block exists.
The docket the coordinator wrote the order figures on sat in the annexe press room and the ink ran.
The client's measurement card is held in the Bellhouse Yard office and the coordinator took that measurement personally at the fitting.
constraints: Supplier block orders are placed by the workroom manager.
The coordinator takes and records client head measurements at fitting.
Menkes will not cut to a nearest-size instruction.
